While the source URL points to a third-party domain (`aimp.ru`), merely declaring a source does not trigger a download during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.

Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no immediate risk of executing malicious code or leaking system information.
